commands.name: GenerateInfrastructureWorkbook
steps: resolve current installation scope and stable read snapshot
stream allowlisted current Infrastructure rows according to INFRASTRUCTURE_WORKBOOK_PROFILE_V1 without opening a writer transaction
write macro-free XLSX to a temporary file in destination filesystem; close, reopen and verify profile/row counts/hash
atomically publish/rename to chosen final filename without overwriting an existing operator file unless a separately explicit replace action is authorized
open short UoW, insert receipt plus export metadata/audit result and commit
rules: generation does not mutate Infrastructure domain entities/relationships
artifact path/content after publication is operator-managed and not authoritative

commands.name: StageInfrastructureWorkbookCheck
steps: validate directory is the exact configured nonrecursive directory and enumerate candidate .xlsx files without following unexpected traversal
for each candidate stabilize file metadata/readability, apply hardened ZIP/active-content/resource preflight, then parse INFRASTRUCTURE_WORKBOOK_PROFILE_V1 in read-only streaming mode
compute file SHA-256, normalized rows and logical fingerprint; identify accepted replay before expensive proposal work
persist run + bounded technical staging in short batched UoWs with one coordinator command/audit identity; parsing never calls domain mutation services
calculate proposals/ambiguities/unknown references outside writer lock and publish staged run atomically
leave source files unchanged
rules: locked/corrupt/unsupported/unsafe files produce bounded per-file failure state without modifying file
discovery never scans recursively or falls back to another directory

commands.name: RejectInfrastructureWorkbookRun
steps: inside UoW require staged/reviewed nonterminal run
insert receipt; transition run/proposals to rejected as applicable and persist row decision evidence needed for audit
minimize technical staging when no pending consumer remains
audit/commit
commands.rule: rejection has zero Infrastructure domain mutation

commands.name: AcceptInfrastructureWorkbookRun
steps: outside lock require complete review with no unresolved invalid/ambiguous/unknown-reference item marked for acceptance and build deterministic bounded mutation plan
inside one UoW re-read run/proposals/replay index/current installation scope and every targeted local entity/revision
if logical fingerprint is already accepted, return idempotent prior result without second domain mutation
insert one outer receipt before all receipt-FK writes

for each accepted row in deterministic sheet/row/action order invoke the same receipt-free Site/Room/Rack/NetworkElement/Model/Cloud/IP/Containment services used by manual commands; same-installation IDs may target exact local identities, foreign IDs may not
revalidate cross-Site, occupancy, primary-IP, containment-cycle, archived-master, identity and blank-nondestructive rules at each owning boundary
if any intended accepted mutation is stale/invalid/indeterminate roll back the entire UoW
persist bounded row decisions, transition run/proposals accepted, insert replay index and audit result refs; commit once
after commit, technical staging minimization may run as a separate safe cleanup operation
rules: one reviewed batch is all-or-nothing for selected accepted mutations
blank optional cells never imply clearing
workbook services have no alternate weak mutation path

job_rule: Large discovery/staging/export may use LLD-01 durable jobs, but every retry is idempotent by run/export identity and no job holds a SQLite writer transaction while parsing or writing XLSX.
